species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 60°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 10–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Northeast wind at 10 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
